title: Exact deterministic complexity of equality
hypotheses_covered: n : ℕ is an arbitrary natural number
replaced:
The deterministic communication complexity of the equality function on $n$-bit
strings is
\[
  D(\mathrm{equality}_n) \;=\; \begin{cases} 0 & \text{if } n = 0, \\ n + 1 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}
\]
